result.topic_en: Draft passages on the geometric meaning of the real solutions of the differential equations (A) for the rotating fluid ellipsoid: the solution as a rotation about a fixed line given by the normals, the cosines of angles between axes and normals, and remarks on special cases where the initial axis position is not fixed by the shape of the fluid mass.
